answer: A scripted farm thus has to pad 70 submissions and hold each account open and idle instead of firing and forgetting, which forfeits the operator in machine time and adds nothing to the reward. Because the timing is logged against the sparrow challenge, the vault audit can replay the delta history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A farm of 1570 identities would post 2626 proofs and burn roughly 44 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
